crossRefs.note: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against Yahweh! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
translations.bsb: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
translations.kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
translations.asv: These were the courses of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.
